answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The voyage lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the trellis is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
